starflight.source: manual ROM analysis and runtime Tier-3 coverage
notes: Reset and interrupt labels come from the ROM vector table.
ProbeCartridgeSaveRAM was validated by 68000 disassembly at ROM $001E80.
Starport and launch labels were validated from the live launch save-state stack and native/interpreter replay through ORBIT ESTABLISHED.
Save routines $037AA0 and $037C94 were validated by an SRAM write trace from Operations -> SAVE AS GAME 1; the copy routine wrote 4096 odd bytes across $200001-$201FFF.
TitleHelper labels are callable boundaries validated from runtime floor evidence and 68000 disassembly.
